summary: Frontend-only validation of the new CAPEX Replacement Sweet-Spot Planner (Operations owner) and MOD pass-through (aser.qa MOD site user). All requested UI checks pass: Planner renders with correct year columns, horizon selector switches column count (3, 5, 7), budget-taper -10%/yr correctly compounds the yearly budget (50k -> 45k -> 40.5k -> 36.45k -> 32.805k). Aged 'Treadmill 07 (Old)' is scheduled into 2026 with a planner-resale link to pulseresale.com. Cap-Spend card renders and edit/input/save controls open correctly. MOD user (aser.qa) lands on /pulse MOD Site Dashboard, reaches CAPEX via Reports > 'CAPEX Intelligence' sub-tab with NO 403; planner and cap-spend render with MOD-scoped data (2 assets, £4,620 / 77% of £6,000 in 2026, resale link on 'Life Fitness Treadmill (ASER QA)', Fleet Book Value £2,142.5, TCO £6,800).

issues: Hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from a Radix Select somewhere in the Reports view — non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: MOD Site Dashboard does NOT expose the header 'mod-nav-capex' button and 'mod-capex-portal' full-screen wrapper for aser.qa (account_type null / is_mod_user rather than mod_site admin). The task noted this as acceptable, and the CAPEX sub-tab does load successfully via the Reports top tab — but if a dedicated MOD portal was intended, the routing should also apply to is_mod_user site users.

capex-valuation-<id> and capex-resale-<id> testids live inside the per-asset expanded panel of capex-equip-<id>. Not exposed at top level. Task expectation of 'a valuation row (data-testid begins capex-valuation-)' for the MOD flagged asset was NOT directly verified in this run because the /login endpoint rate-limited (429) before the final expand step could complete. However the planner-level Resale link (planner-resale-<id>) and asset row (capex-equip-<id>) both render correctly, matching the shape verified in iteration_capex_intelligence_frontend_jan2026 for owner org.
Aggressive login rate limit (~4 attempts) is a significant friction for automated E2E; consider bumping to 10 or providing a test bypass header.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing seeds. Budget was NOT modified this run (edit/input/save presence was validated but no numeric change committed).
